bull_case: 유리한 사업·자본배분 가정이 유지되면 기준 점수보다 높은 결과가 가능하다.
bear_case: 성장·마진·자본배분이 정상화되고 핵심 불확실성이 불리하게 전개되면 기준 점수보다 낮아질 수 있다.
thesis: Customer value is broad but heterogeneous. Berkshire owns many essential or repeat-use businesses, yet consolidated retention metrics are sparse, so product quality is easier to verify at subsidiary than parent level.

evidence.claim: Berkshire's major activities include insurance, rail transportation, utilities/energy, manufacturing, services and retail.
PCC Q1 2026 revenue rose 8.2%, with aerospace revenue up 9.4% and industrial gas turbine products up 18.9%.
Clayton Homes Q2 2026 revenue was about $3.4B and H1 $6.3B.
Insurance underwriting produced $3.448B after-tax operating earnings in H1 2026.

counterevidence: GEICO Q2/H1 loss ratios worsened year over year as claim frequency/severity increased.
Some building-products businesses faced lower demand due to weak home construction.
Consolidated disclosure lacks customer retention/NPS/market-share measures.
unknowns: Customer retention and pricing elasticity by major non-insurance subsidiary.
falsifiers: Major subsidiaries require sustained subsidies to retain customers.
Pricing power disappears while volumes decline across multiple units.
A single customer/product loss permanently impairs consolidated economics.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Profitable mature subsidiaries demonstrate customer value; growth is not dependent on marketing/subsidy without customer value.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Diversification across insurance, rail, energy and many operating companies prevents fatal dependence on one product/customer/regulation.

subscores.rationale: BNSF freight, utility service, insurance and industrial components are mission-critical or economically necessary.
Customer persistence is high in many subsidiaries, but Berkshire does not disclose consolidated retention or wallet-share metrics.
Major units are profitable without parent-level marketing subsidy, though capital intensity differs materially by business.
